summary: Turn analytics and AI assets into supported, reusable products. Practise lifecycle, quality and adoption planning. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Data product management helps analytics and AI teams turn datasets and models into supported, reusable products. For analytics product managers, data stewards and AI product owners, the course covers lifecycle ownership, discovery, quality and service measures, plus adoption and cost-to-serve tracking. It also addresses metadata and reuse decisions, roadmap prioritisation, and operational oversight of AI assets, without requiring software development.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for taking analytics and AI assets from a single-use deliverable to a supported product. It suits intermediate learners who work across data, product, governance or business teams.
modules: NIST AI RMF for Asset Operations
prerequisites: Working familiarity with data, analytics or AI delivery and basic product planning is expected. No coding or programming is required; exercises focus on product decisions, worksheets and planning artefacts.
